dimensions.note: Deployment token is sent only to apiUrl (GraphQL path resolves on the same host); upstream reads stay anonymous/upstreamToken. No token in resources or logs.
Gate state logged once per run; each result logs auto-merge state.
GraphQL errors at HTTP 200 are thrown; arm/blocked failures fail the method after the resource is written; label failure is reported, not swallowed.
95 tests: scope matrix incl. 0.x minor and prerelease, gate, not-armable human branch, held, label-after-arm, clean-status merge, GHES GraphQL URL, rulesets parsing.
Re-runs: already-armed and held are no-ops; branch-exists refusal prevents retrying a rejected version. Arming is never undone (documented).

enablePullRequestAutoMerge, rules/branches and the clean-status merge match GitHub docs, but the label POST (auto-creates the label) and the clean-status fallback are exercised against stubs only; first live proof is the sodden Dependabot PR.
No new long-lived resources; fetch bodies consumed by request().
Independent review scan: no internal hostnames, IPs, vault or private repo names in code, tests, docs or commits.
autoMerge enum nullable, set on every result; armed counter always written.
No new CRUD surface; bump remains create-only on PRs.
autoMerge without requiredChecks throws before any call; ruleset gate checked before arming.
bump still writes the single `bump` instance with one schema.
Model version 2026.11.10.1 with no-op upgrade; only method arguments changed.
